998188 ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT("Agreement") made as of the I day of January, 2005 by and between 155 EAST 23RD, LLC ("155"), a limited liability company having an address c/o J.R. Equities, Inc., 117 East 29th Street, New York, N.Y. 10016, and TWENTY THIRD AND THIRD, LLC and YL 23RD STREET LLC, as tenants in common (collectively “YL"), both New York limited liability companies having an address c/o YL Real Estate Developers, 111 Great Neck Road, Suite 205, Great Neck, N.Y. 11021. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,155 is the owner infee of a certain parcel of land,with the buildings andimprovementsthereon,locatedintheBoroughofManhattan,City,CountyandStateofNew York, known as Lot 33 in Block 879 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and by street address, 155-157 East 23rd Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the “155 Land," said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the“155 Building,”and the 155 Land and the 155 Building being herein collectively called the “155 Premises"); WHEREAS, YL is the owner in fee of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York,known asLots36-40and 43inBlock879ontheTaxMapoftheCityofNewYork,and by thestreet addressof302-316ThirdAvenue and161East23rdStreet,NewYork,NewYork, and more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land any future replacement thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the “YL Building,”' and the YL Land and the YL Building being herein collectively called the “YL Premises"); WHEREAS,YL desires to construct a new building on the YLPremises with a bulk in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on the YL Land under the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, effective December 15, 1961 (the“Zoning Resolution") if the YL Land was considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; WHEREAS, there are Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) which are appurtenant to the 155 Land which are not utilized by the 155 Building (the “155 Excess Floor Area Development Rights") and are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS, YL has entered into separate agreements for the purchase of Floor Area Development Rights with the owners of the Additional Parcels (as hereinafter defined); NY55/421648.7 D-1
